name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme
description: Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme to award scholarships to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest dropouts at Class VIII and encourage secondary stage education.
department: Department of School Education and Literacy
target_beneficiaries: Meritorious students from economically weaker sections studying in Class IX to XII in Government or Local Body schools
Students whose parental annual income does not exceed Rs. 3,50,000
benefits: Scholarship of Rs. 12,000 per annum (Rs. 1,000 per month) from Class IX through Class XII, credited directly to student bank accounts through DBT via PFMS.

source_evidence.statement: Administered by the Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education, Government of India.
Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme covering school students across all States and Union Territories.
Students studying as regular students in government, government-aided and local body schools with parental income up to Rs. 3.5 lakh who pass the selection test.
Rs. 12,000 per annum disbursed annually into student bank accounts through PFMS-DBT mode.
Official registration and renewal portal hosted on National Scholarship Portal at scholarships.gov.in.
Continuous implementation with 100,000 fresh scholarships awarded each year across States and UTs.

eligibility_criteria.limitations: Students of Kendriya Vidyalayas, Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas, Sainik Schools, and residential schools run by State Governments are not eligible.

required_documents.title: Parental Income Certificate
required_documents.description: Revenue department proof confirming parental income <= Rs. 3,50,000 p.a.

required_documents.title: Class VII Marksheet
required_documents.description: Marksheet showing minimum 55% marks (50% for SC/ST) in Class VII examination.

required_documents.title: Student Bank Account Passbook
required_documents.description: Bank account in student's name in SBI or any public sector bank.
